name: @red-cup-engineering/read-hive-engine-fill-service
description: Reads one Hive-Engine `marketpools.swapTokens`, `market.sell`, or `market.buy` fill by transaction id from at least two public nodes, read-only, shaping it into the standard venue-fill record or refusing (never shaping a fill) when the nodes disagree on `databaseHash`, the operation cannot be resolved unambiguously, its contract/action is unsupported, or its logs carry no completed transfer to and from the queried account.
